profiles.name: World Director
profiles.description: Route scoped worldbuilding or establish premise, tone, audience, and testable pillars.

profiles.name: Reference Analyst/Adapter
profiles.description: Analyze supplied works with versioned evidence; optionally transform techniques into original proposals.

profiles.name: Canon Custodian
profiles.description: Track authoritative claims, contradictions, revisions, and dependency impact.

profiles.name: Magic Fusion Specialist
profiles.description: Define coherent world-level powers, limits, costs, and interactions.

profiles.name: Geography & Ecology Specialist
profiles.description: Build physical regions, climate, water, resources, habitats, and ecological constraints.

profiles.name: History & Timeline Specialist
profiles.description: Build a dated causal past and distinguish truth from attributed accounts.

profiles.name: Culture & Everyday Life Specialist
profiles.description: Build lived communities through material conditions, practice, and variation.

profiles.name: Faction & Culture Specialist
profiles.description: Design institutions and powers with goals, resources, membership, and relationships.

profiles.name: Cosmology & Belief Specialist
profiles.description: Develop sacred practice while distinguishing belief from authorial truth.

profiles.name: Economy & Trade Specialist
profiles.description: Explain how labor, resources, infrastructure, ownership, and exchange sustain communities.

profiles.name: Language & Naming Specialist
profiles.description: Create consistent names and terms grounded in communities, contact, and history.

profiles.name: Bestiary Specialist
profiles.description: Define creatures as living entities in habitats and societies.

profiles.name: Character Bible Specialist
profiles.description: Create individuals with motives, relationships, histories, and knowledge limits.

profiles.name: Location Bible Specialist
profiles.description: Assemble an inhabitable place from geography, control, history, and present life.

profiles.name: Cartographer Specialist
profiles.description: Maintain a geographically consistent atlas and gazetteer with scale and uncertainty.

profiles.name: Environmental Storytelling Specialist
profiles.description: Turn established causes into discoverable traces with fair inference.

profiles.name: Fiction Writer
profiles.description: Outline or write original fiction and dialogue with causal structure and viewpoint.

profiles.name: Knowledge & Revelations Specialist
profiles.description: Plan who learns what, by which routes, and at what spoiler level.

profiles.name: Quest Narrative Specialist
profiles.description: Specify player actions, branches, and consequences for a quest.

profiles.name: Narrative Systems Specialist
profiles.description: Specify reusable narrative reaction rules and contracts.

profiles.name: Persistent State Specialist
profiles.description: Define authority, scope, transitions, replay, and concurrency for persistent outcomes.

profiles.name: Live Narrative Roadmap Specialist
profiles.description: Plan causal future story waves without inventing release schedules.

profiles.name: Live Events Specialist
profiles.description: Design multiplayer events with phases, shared outcomes, and late access.

profiles.name: Player Societies Specialist
profiles.description: Support collective player agency or document emergent history with evidence.

profiles.name: Onboarding & Legacy Specialist
profiles.description: Orient newcomers and returners and preserve access to missed history.

profiles.name: Narrative Editor
profiles.description: Edit or critique a draft at the requested level while preserving intent and canon.

profiles.name: Narrative QA Reviewer
profiles.description: Review one artifact through a requested behavior, access, or implementation lens.

profiles.name: Game Systems Designer
profiles.description: Specify game mechanics in prose: loops, resources, rules and progression shape, without balance numbers.
